ios.desc:
Keeping in touch with our loved ones needs a new home. A place to capture noteworthy moments in life void of likes and emojis. A place to safely store unedited thoughts and feelings about the present and share with the people who matter most. A place to see and be seen for who we are becoming. Introducing Penciv – the place where thoughts become thoughtful with the love of a letter, and the ease of a text.
 
Penciv's journal takes mindfulness and intentionality to another level. The only social or journaling app that uses a fully customizable feelings wheel, Penciv is specifically designed to help you transform your feelings into data towards who you are becoming. Journal to keep track of life's most precious moments and share them to help your friends relive those meaningful moments. Check in on daily prompts to kick start time to reflect, and see what people are saying from around the globe.
 
Prompts 
Check in with prompts every day for a new set of questions to help you reflect and practice mindfulness. Answer questions in Prompt Decks with your friends, or see what people say from all around the continent for inspiration, intentionality, and perspective.
 
Journaling 
Using Penciv's unique emotion wheel, capture how you're feeling and categorize each entry to gain insights on who and what is are influencing you in each journal entry. Attach photos and voice to add to the look and feel of each journal entry. Add categories, location and key people so you can identify your own patterns.
 
Sharing
Share and receive intentional text with assets rich with emotion. React and respond using your own personal feelings wheel. Don't ever confuse someone's tone over text, again!
 
Data Page
Every month, see what's been making you feel a certain way. Get real data for practicing mindfulness and intentionality - See how full life is from month-to-month!
 
Loops
You know those heartfelt texts that you read once and lose in the text message ether? Don't lose any more meaningful messages with each moment being organized to each individual friend.
 
Memory Lane
Take a stroll down memory lane to see how full your story is!
